title: Applications of Genetic Principles
objectives: Apply genetic knowledge to clinical scenarios

diagnostic_tech.title: Genetic Testing
diagnostic_tech.content:
• PCR-based: Sanger sequencing, fragment analysis
  • Microarrays: SNP chips, CGH
  • NGS: Whole exome/genome sequencing

therapeutic_apps.title: Genetic Therapies
therapeutic_apps.content:
Gene Addition
• Viral vectors (AAV for hemophilia B)
• Non-viral methods (lipid nanoparticles)
Gene Editing
• CRISPR-Cas9 (β-thalassemia trials)
• Base/prime editing

ethical_considerations.title: Bioethical Issues
ethical_considerations.content:
Genetic Discrimination

GINA Act (2008): Prohibits health insurance discrimination

Challenges: Life insurance, employment

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.content:
Why can't we use CRISPR to edit all disease-causing mutations?

Technical limitations include delivery efficiency, off-target effects, and mosaicism. Ethical constraints apply for germline editing.
